column1: There are two agents behind the Iguana Airlines ticket counter.
column2: 鬣蜥航空售票櫃檯後有兩名售票員。

column1: The ticket agent returns your gaze. The lady traveler waits impatiently.
column2: 售票員回望你的目光。女旅客不耐煩地等候。

column1: The agent meets your steady gaze with a smile.
column2: 售票員面帶微笑迎上你穩定的目光。

column1: The man sitting down looks terminally bored.
column2: 坐著的男人看起來無聊透頂。

column1: Just normal-looking airline passengers....
column2: 只是看起來很普通的航空旅客……

column1: The gentleman says "Hey, fella! What're you trying to do?"
column2: 那位先生說：「嘿，老兄！你想做什麼？」

column1: There are lounge chairs for the convenience of weary travelers. There is an ashtray next to them.
column2: 這裡有供疲憊旅客使用的休息椅，旁邊放著煙灰缸。

column1: On the wall hangs an abstract painting.
column2: 牆上掛著一幅抽象畫。

column1: There are two ticket agents behind the ticket counter.
column2: 售票櫃檯後有兩名售票員。

column1: This abstract painting, entitled "After the Dust Settles", was created by "Vu", our very favorite computer artist.
column2: 這幅名為《塵埃落定》的抽象畫，由我們最喜愛的電腦藝術家「Vu」創作。

column1: Nasty-looking things. Some of 'em have lipstick on them.
column2: 看起來很噁心的東西，有些上面還沾著口紅。

column1: It's a velveteen braided rope similar to the ones found in some movie theaters.
column2: 這是條天鵝絨編織繩，類似某些電影院裡的隔離繩。

column1: You look, and all you see are nasty old butts.
column2: 你看了一眼，只看見噁心的老菸蒂。

column1: No one near you has any of that information.
column2: 你附近沒有人知道那些資訊。

column1: I'm sorry sir, explains the ticket agent, "but the passenger list is confidential information."
column2: 售票員解釋：「抱歉，先生，但旅客名單是機密資訊。」

column1: Not one of your best ideas, Sonny.
column2: 這不是你最好的點子，桑尼。

column1: Hi there!
column2: 嗨！

column1: So long!
column2: 再見！

column1: Yes...what??
column2: 是的……什麼事？？

column1: That would be an entirely unprofessional and inappropriate action at this moment.
column2: 現在做那件事完全不專業，也不恰當。

column1: The one on the floor?? Y-E-C-C-C-H-H-H-H!!
column2: 地板上的那個？？噁——心——！！

column1: It's on its way to the plane.
column2: 它正在前往飛機。

column1: You have it.
column2: 你拿著它。

column1: You can't get it here.
column2: 你在這裡拿不到。

column1: Hey, buddy!! What do you think you're doing??
column2: 「嘿，老兄！！你以為你在做什麼？？」
